args.command: ls -la ~/notes 2>/dev/null; ls -la ~/Desktop/notes 2>/dev/null; ls -la ~/Documents/notes 2>/dev/null; find ~ -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "notes" 2>/dev/null | head -20
